describe: The outputs of the first and only run of the registered rule, fixed as the baseline that RFC-004 replays. Replaying run.py on the pinned inputs at the pinned commit must reproduce positions_*.csv and report.json byte for byte; a second run on 2026-11-22 did. report.md is rendered from report.json by report.py.
open_items: The raw market inputs exist only on the machine that ran the baseline; see the snapshot manifest. A durable copy is needed before another machine can replay it.
